mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Connect AI tools to Plane with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
mcp.token_hint: Paste a token to enable one-click setup. It is only used on this page.
mcp.workspace_auto_hint: The AI first lists accessible workspaces with workspace(action="list"), then explicitly passes workspace_slug for each target. One connection works across workspaces without manual switching, and permissions are checked on every request.
mcp.chatgpt_hint: In the ChatGPT official client, open Settings → Plugins → Add in the upper-right corner → Add MCP server. Enter plane, select Streamable HTTP, and use the server URL below. Configure token authentication using the TOML shown here, save, and restart. ChatGPT web does not read local configuration.
mcp.agent_hint: Select Agent setup and give the copied prompt to your AI assistant. Configure your token separately.
mcp.chatgpt_skill_hint: Upload the Skill package through Plugins → Skills → Create if your account supports uploads. Installing a Skill does not connect MCP; Plane's token authentication may not be supported by ChatGPT.
mcp.codex_skill_hint: Save SKILL.md to ~/.agents/skills/plane-workflow/SKILL.md. Merge the MCP configuration into ~/.codex/config.toml and provide PLANE_API_TOKEN to the Codex process.
mcp.openai_config_hint: Merge this into ~/.codex/config.toml. Set PLANE_API_TOKEN in the environment of the client process; the configuration references it without storing your token.
mcp.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the configuration manually.
mcp.code_description: Copy this configuration into your client.
mcp.template_hint: Replace {token} with your personal access token before connecting.

skills.title: Skills and plugins
skills.description: Install all 8 Plane workflow skills for planning work, breaking down requirements, and preparing updates.
skills.connection_hint: Every channel installs the same 8 skills. Skill installation does not connect MCP. In the MCP menu, get the URL and token, then provide them manually in your client without exposing the token. No OAuth is required.
skills.chatgpt_hint: In the ChatGPT desktop app, open Settings in the lower-left corner, then select Plugins. Select Add in the upper-right corner → Add plugin marketplace.
skills.generic_step_1: Run the command below to install all 8 skills from the shared GitHub source using npx skills.
skills.generic_step_2: Choose your AI client and project or global scope in the installer. Use npx skills list to verify installation (add --global for global skills), then reload skills in your client.
skills.generic_step_3: Alternatively, download the ZIP below and upload or install each of its 8 skill directories using your client’s supported method. Chat attachments do not install skills.
skills.generic_step_4: In the MCP menu, get the URL and token and connect manually in your client. Verify with a read-only query; never display the token.
skills.desktop_step_2: Select Add → Add marketplace → Add from a repository and enter https://github.com/retronew/plane.
skills.desktop_step_3: Install plane-workflow from plane-ai for all 8 skills. Alternatively, upload the plugin ZIP below in Customize → Plugins.
skills.desktop_step_4: Verify all 8 skills load, then connect manually using the URL and token from the MCP menu. The package includes no MCP connection or credential form.
skills.chatgpt_step_1: In the ChatGPT desktop app, open Settings in the lower-left corner, then select Plugins.
skills.chatgpt_step_2: Select Add in the upper-right corner → Add plugin marketplace.
skills.chatgpt_step_3: Enter https://github.com/retronew/plane. If a branch or revision field is shown, enter preview; leave any repository subdirectory field empty and add the marketplace.
skills.chatgpt_step_4: Install plane-workflow from plane-openai for all 8 skills. Alternatively, extract the skills ZIP and upload or install each of the 8 skills using your client’s supported method. Configure MCP manually in the MCP menu; verify loading on this host, without assuming cloud or web sync.
skills.desktop_hint: Install all 8 skills through Customize → Plugins using plane-ai or the plugin ZIP. Alternatively, extract the skills ZIP and upload or install each of its 8 skills where supported. Configure MCP separately with a URL and token.
skills.claude_hint: Install plane-workflow for all 8 skills, then open the MCP menu to connect manually with a URL and token. No plugin credential form is needed.
skills.openai_hint: Use the official Codex CLI on the same host to install and verify all 8 skills. If the CLI is unavailable, follow the manual steps. Use the 8-skill ZIP as a fallback; configure MCP separately. Cloud and web sync is not guaranteed.
